jobs.label: New lead
jobs.meaning: add a new sales lead or prospect to the CRM
jobs.note: CRM-L2 builds one of the four jobs of crm_platform.md section 11. It opens the quick-create form and never saves.

jobs.label: New deal
jobs.meaning: add a new deal or sales opportunity to the CRM
jobs.note: CRM-X2 (crm_platform.md section 19.6). Opens a form or a list in the CRM, and saves nothing. WARNING: not the word contact (Find a colleague owns it). Not crm or sales (New lead owns them).

jobs.label: Log a call
jobs.meaning: log a phone call with a lead, a contact or a customer in the CRM
jobs.note: CRM-X2 (crm_platform.md section 19.6). Opens a form in the CRM, and saves nothing.

jobs.label: Find a record
jobs.meaning: find a lead, a deal, a contact or a company in the CRM
jobs.note: CRM-X2 (crm_platform.md section 19.6). Opens a list in the CRM, and saves nothing.
